steps.caption: Client accounts
steps.narration: Here's how to choose a protection and read its preview before anything touches Google.

steps.caption: Advanced
steps.narration: Open Advanced, Bulk protections and domain mapping.

steps.caption: One preview per account
steps.narration: Each selected account gets its own preview. No Google settings change until you confirm it.

steps.caption: Five protections
steps.narration: Protection offers five kinds, starting with presence-only location targeting.

steps.caption: Shared negative keywords
steps.narration: Shared negative keywords adds a named list of phrases to the account.

steps.caption: The starter list
steps.narration: The starter list is editable, one phrase per line: jobs, careers, salary, training.

steps.caption: Click Guard IP exclusions
steps.narration: Click Guard IP exclusions uses the newest flagged IPs from the client's mapped site.

steps.caption: Inside Google's limit
steps.narration: It rotates out the oldest exclusions to stay inside Google's five hundred per campaign.

steps.caption: Ad schedule
steps.narration: Ad schedule sets the hours for each day, in each account's own timezone.

steps.caption: Queue protection previews
steps.narration: Tick accounts and choose Queue protection previews. That builds a preview, nothing more.

steps.caption: Protection previews
steps.narration: Protection previews lists them, one per account.

steps.caption: Review preview
steps.narration: Choose Review preview on the negative keyword one.

steps.caption: The summary
steps.narration: The summary says what happens: add the missing phrase-match negatives and attach the list to one campaign.

steps.caption: The warnings
steps.narration: Warnings come next, like free also blocking free estimate.

steps.caption: Operations and expiry
steps.narration: Then the number of operations and when the preview expires.

steps.caption: Nothing written
steps.narration: Close it. Nothing has changed in Google.

steps.caption: Menu: Protection previews
steps.narration: Protection previews is in the Agency Ads and LSA menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to preview a Google Ads protection for clients | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the protections in the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager: presence-only targeting, shared negative keywords, placement exclusions, ad schedules and Click Guard IP exclusions. You will choose one, queue a preview per account, and read a preview's summary, warnings and expiry before anything changes in Google.
